I installed [Notion]( https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Notion_(productivity_software) in November 2023 , then again in October 2024 when we visited Peter in Da Nang. It looks nice and has many features as a commercial product. Open source Since 2018 I use GitHub. And like many others I like Open Source, open standards and free access to information. I learned HTML in 1999, LaTeX in 2000 and Markdown in 2018 with my students, finally combining it with Python into a Jupyter Notebook in 2019. So Obsidian it is. So I installed Obsidian on my iPhone on November 21rd, 2024 , during my visa run to Cambodia. And I made my first entry with my iPad. This here is it! Third became a daily note, named First use of Obsidian . But the question of syncing took another year to finally find a fitting repository.
